diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate upward trend (a net rise of ~33% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. trajectory.thought: The series has a strong trend but unstable model rankings (ranking_tau=-0.06) and high error correlation among tree-based models. A robust combination like trimmed_mean on the full pool is a good starting point to mitigate variance from any single unstable model without overfitting weights. I will test `trimmed_mean` on `pool_full`.

The ranking instability (tau -0.06) and high error correlation among top models suggest that simple averaging may be too sensitive to individual model errors, while the trimmed mean already performed well by mitigating outliers. However, robust combinations like DBA or weighted schemes accounting for correlation might still improve upon the trimmed mean. I will test a Dynamic Bayesian Average (dba), which is designed to be robust against model misspecification and outlier errors, potentially offering better stability than the fixed trimming of the current leader.
